text:
kevin: Quick mockup question 1 — attached a tiny persistent banner for the prompt-sets regression list. looking for quick UX/a11y thoughts before i upload to figma.

lina: Can you paste the flow here? is this intended to block bulk-approve or just warn?

kevin: Intended as a soft block by default. banner appears when a run contains failing tests and disables bulk-approve unless someone explicitly acknowledges or reviews. But admins can bypass via a "fast lane" permission.

jia: intent sounds good. what does the banner look like? intrusive or compact?

kevin: compact: 44px height, icon, short summary (e.g. "2 failing  1 flaky"), and two CTAs: "Review failures" (primary) and "Acknowledge & continue" (secondary). keyboard hint: "D to open failures".

aria: a11y: ensure banner is announced by screen readers and CTAs are reachable by keyboard. recommend role="status" aria-live="polite" and a short message like "Regression run: 2 failing". also make sure the skip/bypass action creates a traceable audit event.

lina: copy nits: "Acknowledge & continue" feels vague. suggest "Acknowledge failures" or "Mark as reviewed". also, CTA order should prioritize review > acknowledge.

kevin: noted. was trying to keep it low friction but agree review should be primary.

jia: about the inline preview idea: could we offer a micro-preview (hover or expand) listing failing test titles? that avoids forcing context switch for quick triage.

lina: micro-preview ok, but ensure its not heavy. maybe only show top 3 titles with icons and a link to full details. animate expansion to reduce layout shift.

aria: keyboard access: Expandable preview must be operable with Enter/Space and focus should move into the preview list. each preview item needs an accessible label like "Test: <prompt set name>  failure summary  open details".

kevin: good. ill include focus management and labels in the spec. one question: for orgs which bypass, should the banner visually indicate "soft-block" vs "hard-block"?

jia: yea, use subtle phrasing: header could be "Recommended: review regressions" and a small badge "soft block" for context. aria label should still convey actionable state.

lina: color/contrast: the orange background suggestion earlier might fail AA for text. propose tokenized warning-bg + dark text (wcag safe). also ensure icon has text alternative.

ui-bot: [auto] regression-run-557: 2 failing, 10 passing, 1 flaky  https://console.redwood/runs/557

kevin: analytics plan: fire events reg_banner_view, reg_banner_open_failures, reg_banner_ack with attributes: run_id, user_role, bypassed.

aria: logging: ack action must be auditable with user id/timestamp and displayed in run activity feed. for SR: screenreader text should be concise: "2 failing, details available" rather than enumerating each test in the live region.

lina: microcopy for the banner body: current draft "Unresolved failures detected  review before approving". maybe too wordy. try "Regression failures detected. Review before approving." keep verbs clear.

kevin: will iterate. deployment plan: behind feature flag, initial 25% org exposure, monitor bulk-approve frequency and number of skipped reviews.

jia: small UX concern: power users who rely on keyboard macros might be slowed. we should provide a keyboard shortcut to dismiss/acknowledge (with confirm) and surface that in the tooltip.

aria: keyboard shortcut must be discoverable and opt-in in settings. also ensure any shortcut doesn't conflict with existing app keys.

kevin: thanks team. i'll push updated figma with the banner states (soft-block, bypassed, acknowledged) and add an accessibility checklist to the ticket. ping me for wording tweaks.

lina: cool, 15m sync tomorrow to sign off before PR.

kevin: thanks all :clap:
